items.prompt: A final value formats as the text -0.000000. What does the output policy require?

options.text: Leave the text unchanged to imply a negative material value.
options.why: The displayed magnitude is rounded zero, and the contract explicitly canonicalizes it.

options.text: Replace every negative computed price, however large, with 0.000000.
options.why: Only textual rounded zero is canonicalized; this is not a blanket numerical clamp.

options.text: Reject every query that produces any zero sensitivity.
options.why: Zero after display rounding can be a valid output.

options.text: Emit 0.000000 for that rounded-zero text only.
options.why: This preserves the specified textual zero policy without hiding materially negative computations.

items.explanation: This preserves the specified textual zero policy without hiding materially negative computations.
